entries.en: to adore, to worship; to revere
entries.notes: 原稿汉字旁另有小注 [jum pa carap.] 性质不明；释义据四栏主文（adorar 即 reuerenciar＝尊）

entries.en: to respect, to honour; to venerate
to worship, to bow in homage

entries.zh: 拜東：官长朝东而拜，此为其礼拜之礼
entries.en: to bow/worship toward the east (the mandarin's act of adoration)
to kneel in worship, to adore on one's knees

entries.zh: 装扮，修饰（整理仪容、梳妆）
entries.en: to adorn, to spruce up; to groom oneself
entries.notes: 汉栏「者」(chià) 与 adornar 语义对应不明，或系原稿形讹（近「著」）；释义依西语词头 componer/afeitar

entries.zh: 妆饰，打扮（为显得好看而修饰自己）
entries.en: to adorn oneself so as to look well; to dress up

entries.zh: 饰妆，妆饰面容（面部化妆）
entries.en: to adorn the face; to put on makeup

entries.zh: 笄，插簪妆饰（女子笄饰其首）
entries.en: for a woman to adorn herself; hairpin (ji)

entries.zh: 上头，束发加饰（梳妆头发）
entries.en: to dress and adorn the head (shangtou, hair-dressing)

entries.zh: 冠巾，戴冠裹巾（头部冠饰）
entries.en: cap and kerchief; to don headwear
entries.notes: 西语 banquin 疑为 bonete/vincha 一类头戴物之形讹；释义据汉栏冠巾与对音

entries.zh: 砖，土砖（模制晒砖，建筑砖石）
entries.en: adobe bricks, moulded mud bricks; building stone
entries.notes: 西语 Adoues 当为 adobes（字母序相符）；汉栏「印土□」第三字未定（塼/增/墼），「印」读模印义则印土磚＝模制土砖，与 adobes 相合，惟此读法含推断成分

entries.en: to perceive, to notice; to judge, to conjecture
to perceive prudently; to be aware
